dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000pdu6](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000pdu6) Magnitude 6.0 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Feb 14 2025 6km NE of Metahara. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 8.9563 longitude 39.934. It impacted 444470 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
